# `entry-heating`

Scenario kind of the engine v0.38.0, family [Mission analysis, links and space operations](../mission-analysis-links-and-space-operations.md). Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service. Every label here is the engine's or the verification matrix's; a kind is MODELLED unless the matrix says otherwise (how a label is earned: the README's Evidence section).

## What it does

3-DoF point-mass atmospheric entry over a rotating spherical Earth or Mars (ballistic or lifting at constant bank), RK4, through US76, an exponential or the Mars atmosphere, with Sutton-Graves stagnation-point convective heating (NASA TR R-376): peak deceleration, heat flux and dynamic pressure, heat load, downrange, a rotating-frame energy check and the Allen-Eggers closed form beside it. Peak deceleration is checked against the published Stardust nominal; heating is MODELLED.

One run of `scenarios/entry-heating-stardust.toml` summarises as: entry-heating (earth): V_rel 12551 m/s, γ 8.43° -> peak 35.4 g at 54.2 km, peak q 746 W/cm² at 62.0 km, heat load 20970 J/cm², peak q_dyn 20.8 kPa; terminal-altitude at 317 s (closed form 60.2 g; MODELLED 3-DoF, no radiative/TPS)

## Limitations

What the run's own report says is not modelled or not validated:

- MODELLED — 3-DoF point-mass entry over a rotating spherical planet (central gravity, no J2), co-rotating windless atmosphere, constant C_D, L/D and bank, RK4; convective stagnation-point heating per NASA TR R-376 (1971), cold wall, NO radiative heating, NO TPS/ablation response, NOT 6-DoF (result `label`)
- Peak deceleration is checked against the published Stardust nominal; heating is MODELLED. (kind catalogue (`kshana kinds --json`))
- Entry interface at a radius of 6503.14 km, inertial 12.9 km/s at -8.2 deg, 45.8 kg, 0.811 m diameter, 0.2202 m nose radius (Desai et al., NASA NTRS 20050042027 and 20090004445). The latitude and heading are an assumed approximate entry over the Pacific; C_D is the module's 60 deg sphere-cone default. Published 6-DoF nominal peak deceleration: 33.4 g. The heating is Sutton-Graves convective only, MODELLED. (scenario file comment, lines 4 to 8)
- Reproducibility & software assurance is MODELLED, not validated: a sub-claim is externally checked, but the whole capability composes modelled pieces, so the capability stays Modelled. (verification matrix (docs/MODELLED-RATIONALE.md))
- Stagnation-point convective entry heating (Sutton-Graves) on a 3-DoF entry is MODELLED, not validated: checked against its own closed-form / analytic identity — catches transcription and coefficient errors, but is not an external oracle. (verification matrix (docs/MODELLED-RATIONALE.md))
